summary: One-time guarded initialization that sets bit 2 of flag byte_8B8EE4, then walks a fixed table backwards from dword_8B78A0 in 19-dword (76-byte) steps across exactly 42 entries, calling EmptyStub_7470 on each entry pointer. The guard makes the whole pass run at most once per process. The table base and the meaning of the per-entry stub call are not evidenced by the packet.

operations.description: Bit-flag guard on byte_8B8EE4: the whole pass runs only while bit 2 is clear, so the registration is performed at most once.
Latch the flag by setting bit 2 in byte_8B8EE4 before the pass runs.
Seed the table cursor v0 from dword_8B78A0 and the iteration counter v1 to 42.
do-while loop counting v1 down from 42, so the body runs exactly 42 times.
Step the cursor backwards by 19 dwords (76 bytes) per iteration, walking the table from its top entry downward.
Call EmptyStub_7470 with each table entry pointer as its single argument.
